title: My workflows
intro: Compose existing creative tools into your own steps.
emptyHistory: No runs yet. Save a template, then prepare a run.
name: Workflow name
pauseAfter: Pause after this step for my review
writerBoundary: Writing always uses approved Writer context. Reviews are never automatically injected into the writer.
archiveConfirm: Archive this template? Existing runs and results remain.
sharing: Exports contain template configuration, not run results, project references or credentials. Check custom instructions for private text before sharing.
sourcesHelp: Sent only when a step enables selected settings. This never selects the entire project.
noSources: No confirmed settings yet. You can use your world idea alone.
contextNeeded: Chapter workflows need a saved manuscript and approved Writer context.
prepareHelp: This only creates a local run record. No AI call occurs until you confirm the next view.
aiDesign: Ask AI to design a workflow
designHelp: Uses the goal above to propose an editable workflow. It does not execute it.
designConsent: Send only this workflow request to the selected model; I understand possible usage charges.
confirmScope: I reviewed the steps, models and source scope and authorize the selected requests.
retryBoundary: Retries target only the unfinished step. Limits: 12 steps, 24 calls and 3 attempts per step. Closing this panel does not stop an active task.
boundary: Compose freely; manuscript/Canon/State approvals and project isolation remain mandatory. Outputs are candidates or reports.
importTooLarge: Template file must be 96 KB or smaller.
imported: Imported as a new template; not executed
openCandidate: Open candidate / Diff in the director
consentRetry: Provider confirmed. Review and continue the current step.
help_world_overview: Proposes one world overview without characters or plot prerequisites.
help_world_rules: Uses the existing nature template for rules, costs and unknowns.
help_world_review: Proposes counterexamples and questions. AI review is not a solver proof.
help_chapter_write: Generates or continues a candidate; never writes the manuscript. Prior input must be a manuscript candidate.
help_chapter_review: Uses the existing literary reviewer on a preceding manuscript candidate.
help_local_proofread: Checks the saved chapter, not an unadopted candidate; no AI call.
help_manual: Retains author directions and waits for an explicit continuation.
basis_WORLD_PROPOSAL: AI world proposal, not established fact
basis_REVIEW_NOT_WRITER_CONTEXT: Separate review; not automatic Writer input
costScope: Enabled AI steps (one request per step; retries are separate; actual provider charges apply):
copyVersion: Copy this version as a new workflow
